newsitem.title: UK: Allied up on fresh talk of Seagram bid.
newsitem.headline: Allied up on fresh talk of Seagram bid.

text.p: Shares in Allied Domecq Plc rose in pre-market trading on Friday as a report in the Times newspaper revived talk of a bid for the drinks group from Seagram of Canada, dealers said.
Allied shares were up 7-1/2p at 435-1/2 by 0712 GMT in volume of 20,000 shares.
The Times said Grand Metropolitan Plc's planned merger with Guinness Plc, given extra spice by Thursday's late stakebuilding in Grand Met by LVMH, had stoked talk of other bids in the sector.
"Allied is in the frame because it's the only other big spirits player (apart from Guinness and Grand Met)," said one analyst, who asked not to be named.
"Also Allied's trading performance over the last few years has been poor and so it looks vulnerable."
Grand Met lost an early rise to be down 1-1/2p at 602 while Guinness dipped 1p to 604.
